text:
Nora: Heads up Edge hardware partner PO (CloudForge Edge NV) stuck on marketplace. Portal rejects EDI mapping: PO number 4521 doesn't match vendor-supplied ASN 04521-EDGE. Partner says it's formatting difference.

Akash: Do we have a mapping rule that strips leading zeros? I think EDI parser treats PO as int and ASNs as strings.

Ben: Confirmed: parser normalizes PO to integer key. ASN came from partner as '04521-EDGE' so mismatch. We can either normalize ASN on ingest or ask partner to resend.

Simone: Partner is in Netherlands, procurement needs this week for a launch. They can't resend quickly because their ERP is slow. Can we do a one-off accept?

finance_bot: ingest-service: reject - EDI_PARSE_ERROR code 2103. payload logged (id: edi-2217).

Raj: Two blockers: (A) EDI parse mismatch, (B) PO signer authority shows a delegated signatory; marketplace enforces legal name on signature must match vendor register. Partner's signer is 'CFO - CloudForge NL' but registry shows 'CloudForge Edge BV'.

Nora: So both the PO id and signer name differ. Partner emailed notarized delegation doc too. How do we process?

Akash: Quick fix: devops can add a temporary ingest rule to accept ASN with optional leading zeros and suffix '-EDGE'. I can ship a hotfix to transform ASN -> strip leading zeros + remove -EDGE suffix. Needs SRE approval and rollback plan.

Ben: Willing to approve if we log the transformation and restrict to vendor_id cf-118. I will add a migration:
```
transform_asn(v) {
  return v.replace(/^0+/, '').replace(/-EDGE$/,'')
}
```

Simone: Legal needs to clear signer delegation doc before we accept. They sent PDF to legal@redwood.com.

Raj: Legal: any objections to accepting delegation doc as proof? Also pricing has hardware warranty redline: partner removed 2-year warranty obligation. Our ops ask to keep warranty clause.

Nora: Partner says warranty removed due to supply chain constraints; wants limited warranty only. This is a commercial negotiation too.

Ben: Ops will accept short-term workaround to get the PO processed, but finance won't invoice until legal confirms signer and commercial signs off on warranty deviation.

finance_bot: invoice-service: hold flagged - missing_warranty_clause. ticket id: INV-8891.

Akash: Implementing hotfix now, patching ingest rule for vendor cf-118. Pushing to prod with feature flag 'cf-edge-edi-accept'. ETA 20m.

Ben: Feature flag set to true for 24h; logging enabled (actor: ben, time: 1736667950).

Simone: Partner uploaded delegation doc; legal validated signature chain (legal:ok). They accepted a temporary limited warranty for this SKU with an addendum to follow. Commercial to confirm.

Raj: Commercial approved addendum. Legal will attach addendum template and require signature within 7 days. If no signature, we will void the PO.

Nora: Partner confirmed they will sign addendum. We received EDI acknowledgement after hotfix and procurement reflection shows PO matched.

finance_bot: ingest-service: success - PO 4521 matched (edi-2217 -> edi-2217-audit).

Ben: Invoicing unblocked, issuing invoice today. Note: open action - add robust EDI normalization rules and signer-delegation upload UX in portal.

Akash: Opening ticket MKT-4216 "EDI normalization: preserve ASN formatting, optional vendor-level transforms". Assigning to eng-platform.

Simone: I'll follow up with partner for the signed addendum. Thanks all.
